quotes.text: Anal retentiveness, micromanaging, anxiety, those are things that actually are great qualities in a superintendent because they run a disciplined, organized job.
If everybody's got it, then nobody's got it. If I send that email out to 25 people, they all just assume that somebody else is doing it.
You should never be making an uninformed decision. And if you're uninformed, then become informed and spare yourself a little bit of heartache because I caused myself plenty.
